name: cicd-runner
description: Project-agnostic CI/CD execution across all projects, running as a persistent Docker service (with real docker-socket access) reached over TCP (localhost:1444) via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's own transports directly, in-process -- works across the Windows/WSL2 boundary, no subprocess spawning.

allowed_directories.title: Additional Allowed Directories
allowed_directories.description: Directories run_in_directory() may access beyond a project's own opencode.json external_directory rules. MCP's own 'roots' protocol -- the spec-native way a server would normally learn this -- cannot be used here: this extension connects directly to a single coordinator session, not through Desktop's own client identity. This setting is the real substitute for that gap, sent to the server as a request header (see index.js/server/bash_mcp_server.py). Optional -- leave empty if only named/mounted projects and their own opencode.json rules need to be reachable.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the projects currently mounted and available to run_command.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run one allowlisted binary with an argv list inside the named project's mounted directory. No shell is invoked.

tools.name: run_in_directory
tools.description: Run one allowlisted binary against an arbitrary subdirectory of the dynamic root, named at call time, in a fresh ephemeral worker container.
